nphi.title: IANPHI Europe Regional Network
nphi.actor: IANPHI Europe Regional Network (chair: Public Health Center of Ukraine)
nphi.with: Public Health Center of the MoH of Ukraine (chair); Austrian National Public Health Institute GÖG (vice chair); 42 member NPHIs
nphi.summary: Network of 42 European NPHIs holding annual meetings (supported by IANPHI since 2006) on health security, climate, data and the future role of NPHIs.

nphi.title: 2025 IANPHI Europe Regional Network Meeting (Oslo)
nphi.with: GÖG; PHC Ukraine; RIVM; ISS; IPH Serbia; IHMT; Santé publique France; INSPQ; Public Health Wales; ECDC; WHO Europe; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; DG HERA
nphi.summary: FHI hosted European NPHIs on their role in health security preparedness, medical countermeasures and resilience amid funding shifts and misinformation.

nphi.title: UNITED4Surveillance – Union and National Capacity Building for Integrated Surveillance
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (WP lead); Robert Koch Institute; Statens Serum Institut; THL; AGES; NVSC Lithuania; SZÚ Czechia; ECDC; Ukraine (observer country)
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action of ~40 public health institutes from 24 countries, coordinated by RIVM, to strengthen integrated infectious disease surveillance (outbreak detection, hospital surveillance, One Health); Norway's NIPH co-leads work…

nphi.title: 2023 IANPHI Europe Annual Meeting (Lisbon)
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Dr. Ricardo Jorge (INSA)
nphi.with: FHI; IPH Montenegro; THL; NIJZ Slovenia; RIVM; Public Health Wales; Sciensano; TAI Estonia; GÖG; EODY; PHC Ukraine; BZgA; UKHSA; Santé publique France; ECDC; WHO Europe; EuroHealthNet
nphi.summary: INSA hosted European NPHIs to discuss new challenges for the next decade, including climate and environment, health security and health data.

nphi.title: Strengthening Biosecurity in Southeast and Eastern Europe (Biosecurity SEEE)
nphi.with: Georgian NCDC; Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology; GIZ; BACAC; WHO; US DTRA; ISTC; STCU
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated needs-based biosafety and biosecurity capacity building, including national assessments, pathogen inventories and train-the-trainer courses in Georgia.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 03 – Knowledge development and transfer of best practice on biosafety/biosecurity/biorisk management
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur d'Algérie; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; L. Sacco University Hospital; Expertise France; VERTIC; Thai Department of Medical Sciences; TIDREC University of Malaya; ISTC; STCU; CNESTEN; University of Coimbra
nphi.summary: Early EU CBRN CoE project in which RIVM, North African Pasteur institutes and other partners built laboratory biorisk-management systems and training for 24 partner countries across Africa, Europe's neighbourhood and South-East Asia.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P44 – CBRN preparedness and response enhancement in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (Belgium); ISEM Institute; IRE-ELiT
nphi.summary: RIVM led the work package that produced a country report for each of the nine partner countries, plus train-the-trainer materials and exercise guidance, to strengthen how first responders handle CBRN incidents.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P57 – CBRN crime scene forensics in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (coordinator); Netherlands Forensic Institute; INCC Belgium; Forensic Science Centre Ivan Vučetić; ISEMI
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which trained forensic investigators to collect evidence at CBRN incident scenes, wrote procedures, and ran six sub-regional exercises.

nphi.title: STEP – immunisation policy capacity
nphi.summary: Building technical capacity for evidence-based decisions on immunisation policies in 16 countries of the WHO European Region.

nphi.title: AMR-EFFECT – RKI support strategy for implementing global AMR commitments (GHPP)
nphi.with: WHO HQ AMR Department; WHO EURO AMR Division (partner-country institutes not named)
nphi.summary: A GHPP project to help partner countries analyse AMR and healthcare-associated infection surveillance data and use them for policy, with a focus on digital tools and One Health approaches.

nphi.title: EMT ReCaP – Emergency Medical Team response capacities and partnerships
nphi.with: WHO EMT Secretariat (WHO HQ); WHO Regional Office for Europe; WHO Regional Office for Africa; Lviv Regional Center for Emergency Medical Care and Disaster Medicine (Ukraine); Ministry of Health and Social Services (Namibia); Ministry of Health (Malawi); Institute of Emergency Care of Sarajevo Canton (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Arbeiter-Samariter-Bund; CADUS e.V.; humedica; Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe (Germany)
nphi.summary: Strengthens Emergency Medical Team crisis response in the WHO AFRO and EURO regions through twinning with German EMTs, cross-regional exchange and communities of practice.

nphi.title: PACT-PHM – Partnerships for population health metrics capacities and tools
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (Denmark); Sciensano (Belgium)
nphi.summary: Builds national capacity to produce burden-of-disease and other population health metrics and embed them in health information systems for policy use.

nphi.title: AMR Contain – support to Ukraine
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Country Office Ukraine; regional CDCs; Kharkiv National Medical University; Zdorovi primary care network
nphi.summary: Supports Ukraine's national action plan on AMR and healthcare-associated infections. Work covers AMR and antibiotic-use data, stewardship, IPC guidelines, laboratory capacity and One Health coordination.

nphi.title: Ukraine–Poland agreement on cooperation in public health (border exercises, epidemiological data exchange)
nphi.with: Chief State Sanitary Doctor of Ukraine / Ministry of Health of Ukraine
nphi.summary: December 2025 agreement between the two chief sanitary officers on IHR implementation, infectious-disease data exchange, joint border-region preparedness, training and alignment with EU standards, including lab diagnostics and AMR.

nphi.title: ECDC MoUs with Serbia, North Macedonia and Ukraine (2025)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia; Institute of Public Health of North Macedonia; Ministry of Health of Ukraine
nphi.summary: In 2025 ECDC signed memoranda of understanding with Serbia's and North Macedonia's institutes of public health and Ukraine's Ministry of Health, alongside those with other enlargement countries, to prepare them for EU integration of…

nphi.title: JADE Health – Joint Action addressing Dementia and Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: FUNDESALUD (Spain, beneficiary); 47 entities in 17 countries
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on dementia with 17 countries including Norway and Ukraine; Slovenian pilot on awareness and stigma reduction.

nphi.title: NUDZ–Ukraine memorandum on public mental health research
nphi.actor: National Institute of Mental Health Czech Republic (NUDZ)
nphi.with: Ukrainian health ministry institutions (not named)
nphi.summary: Memorandum signed 4 May 2025 to build capacity for public mental health research, train 45 young researchers and help set up a Ukrainian centre of excellence.

nphi.title: JA PreventNCD – Cancer and other NCD prevention: action on health determinants
nphi.actor: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (FHI) and Norwegian Directorate of Health
nphi.with: Ukrainian partner institute not named on the source page; FHI; Sciensano; ISS
nphi.summary: A large joint action that tackles shared risk factors for cancer and other non-communicable diseases through policy, health-determinant and individual-level interventions.

nphi.title: EUCanScreen – European Joint Action on Cancer Screening
nphi.with: Ukrainian and Moldovan partner institutes not named on the source pages; RIVM coordinates the Dutch participation
nphi.summary: Supports countries in implementing the updated EU cancer screening recommendations, covering breast, cervical, colorectal, lung, prostate and gastric cancer.

nphi.title: EU-JAMRAI 2 – Joint Action on Antimicrobial Resistance and Healthcare-Associated Infections
nphi.actor: Inserm (with the French Ministry of Health)
nphi.with: Ukrainian partner institute not named; NPHIs among the more than 120 partners
nphi.summary: A One Health joint action to turn EU and national AMR action plans into practice, covering stewardship, infection prevention, surveillance and awareness.

nphi.title: EUCanScreen – implementation of cancer screening programmes
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: University of Latvia (host organisation); 29 partnering countries incl. 25 EU states, Norway, Iceland, Ukraine, Moldova
nphi.summary: Multi-country project implementing cancer screening programmes; Slovenia's NIJZ participates alongside partners from EU and non-EU countries including Ukraine and Moldova.

nphi.title: EUCanScreen – cancer screening implementation
nphi.actor: Latvian Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC)
nphi.with: University of Latvia (host); partner organisations in 29 countries
nphi.summary: SPKC participates in work packages on cancer screening in a multi-country project that also includes Ukraine, Moldova, Norway and Iceland.

nphi.title: Health resilience in the Eastern Partnership – preparedness and response component
nphi.actor: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (mental health and workforce components); national public health authorities of the Eastern Partnership countries
nphi.summary: EU-funded initiative in which ECDC helps the Eastern Partnership countries assess and strengthen their preparedness for serious cross-border health threats. The work includes regional simulation exercises, workshops, webinars, an expert…

nphi.title: JACARDI – Joint Action on Cardiovascular Diseases and Diabetes
nphi.with: Ukrainian partner institute not named; ISS (coordinator); Sciensano; Santé publique France; NIJZ
nphi.summary: Pilots and scales up interventions to prevent and manage cardiovascular disease and diabetes, from health literacy to screening and patient pathways.

nphi.title: EU-WISH – EU Wastewater Integrated Surveillance for Public Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health; Statens Serum Institut (supporting organisation); partners from 26 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action with partners in 26 countries (incl. non-EU Norway and Ukraine) to strengthen wastewater-based surveillance of biological and chemical agents.

nphi.title: JACARDI – Joint Action on Cardiovascular Disease and Diabetes
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (coordinator); 76 partners in 21 European countries
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action coordinated by Italy's ISS with 21 countries including Ukraine, on cardiovascular disease and diabetes prevention and care.

nphi.title: HSE support to Ukraine: emergency resuscitation training and equipment
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.with: University College Dublin (Ukraine Trauma Project); NGOs
nphi.summary: The HSE Global Health Programme funds an emergency resuscitation training project with University College Dublin and sends medical equipment to Ukraine through NGOs.

nphi.title: CDC Eastern Europe and Central Asia Regional Office (EECA)
nphi.with: Ministry of health counterparts (not named); regional FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's EECA regional office in Tbilisi (2021) supports ten countries on AMR, hepatitis C elimination, genomic sequencing, lab quality, surveillance, workforce development and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: Global Laboratory Leadership Programme in Ukraine
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; Ministry of Health; Association of Public Health Laboratories (APHL)
nphi.summary: CDC and APHL launched the Global Laboratory Leadership Program in Ukraine in 2021, training laboratory leaders with a One Health approach.

nphi.title: CDC–IANPHI partnership for NPHIs
nphi.with: IANPHI; WHO/Europe (Ukraine)
nphi.summary: Since 2011: planning support for Zambia's NPHI (2015), consultation for Burkina Faso's institute (2018), an assessment of Ukraine's Public Health Center (2019) and Staged Development Tool workshops in several countries.

nphi.title: CDC Ukraine country office
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Ukraine; Public Health Center of Ukraine (UPHC); regional CDC laboratories
nphi.summary: CDC opened a Ukraine office in 2010 and supports the Ministry of Health and the Public Health Center of Ukraine on health security, the advanced (2018) and frontline (2021) FETP, laboratory leadership, AMR, immunization, emergency…

nphi.title: SSI Strategic Sector Cooperation – Ukraine
nphi.summary: Danish SSC support for Ukraine's public health resilience, infectious disease preparedness and data-driven surveillance during reconstruction.

nphi.title: 2024 IANPHI Europe Regional Network Meeting (Budva)
nphi.actor: Institute of Public Health of Montenegro (IJZCG)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (network chair); Public Health Center of Ukraine (vice chair); ECDC; GÖG; Public Health Scotland; ASPHER; HERA; WHO Europe
nphi.summary: Montenegro's IPH hosted European NPHIs and ECDC to discuss climate and health, research preparedness for emergencies, conflict-related AMR and regional collaboration.

nphi.title: EMIS-2023 – European MSM internet survey extended to Eastern Europe/Central Asia
nphi.with: Deutsche Aidshilfe (Germany); ECOM – Eurasian Coalition on Health, Rights, Gender and Sexual Diversity; SEE RCN – South Eastern Europe Regional TB and HIV Community Network
nphi.summary: Extended online health and behaviour surveys among MSM to EECA and Western Balkans to strengthen HIV/STI surveillance.

nphi.title: Wartime antimicrobial resistance response in Ukraine
nphi.with: Public Health Center of the Ministry of Health of Ukraine; Ministry of Health of Ukraine; regional hospitals in Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi and Vinnytsia; WHO Europe; ICAP; ESCMID
nphi.type: Joint response/research (MMWR Notes from the Field)
nphi.summary: From mid-2022, US CDC, Ukraine's Public Health Center and partners assessed infection control and laboratory capacity in three regions and ran point-prevalence surveys. The surveys found that 60% of healthcare-associated infections…

nphi.title: IANPHI Europe mission to the Poland–Ukraine border
nphi.with: Polish national public health institute (host)
nphi.summary: In May 2022, Poland's NPHI invited an IANPHI Europe delegation to visit refugee reception sites on the Ukrainian border. The mission produced a report with recommendations.

nphi.title: 2022 IANPHI Europe Annual Meeting (Tallinn)
nphi.actor: National Institute for Health Development (TAI), Estonia
nphi.with: IANPHI Europe member NPHIs; Public Health Center of Ukraine (assisted under network workplan)
nphi.summary: TAI hosted the 2022 IANPHI Europe meeting with over 60 participants; the network's workplan included assisting Ukraine's Public Health Center after a May 2022 mission to Poland.

nphi.title: BoCO-19 – Corona Global – Burden of COVID-19 population health metrics
nphi.with: National Association of Public Health (Albania); Public Health and Reforms Center (Azerbaijan); IPH FBiH & PHI Republika Srpska (Bosnia and Herzegovina); NCDC Georgia; Al-Farabi Kazakh National University; 'Healthy Future' (Kyrgyzstan); IPH Kosovo; Mongolian National University of Medical Sciences; IPH Montenegro; University of Belgrade (Serbia); Ministry of Health (Türkiye); Ukrainian Institute on Public Health Policy & Public Health Center (Ukraine); Tashkent Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education
nphi.summary: Harmonised burden-of-disease methods for COVID-19 and tested them for outbreak surveillance.

nphi.title: COVIMPACT Hepatitis – Corona Global – COVID-19 impact on hepatitis elimination in EECA
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe
nphi.summary: Assessed pandemic impact on hepatitis B/C elimination programmes and supported recovery strategies.

nphi.title: FUTURE International UZB/UKR – Corona Global – Telemedicine for COVID-19 intensive care
nphi.with: Ministry of Health Uzbekistan; Ministry of Health Ukraine; Republican Research Centre for Emergency Medicine (Uzbekistan); Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin
nphi.summary: Tele-ICU and web-based learning for COVID-19 clinical management, later extended to war-related care in Ukraine.

nphi.title: EURO NITAGs – Strengthening NITAGs in middle-income WHO EURO countries
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe – VPI Programme
nphi.summary: Built capacity of immunization advisory groups for evidence-based recommendations.

nphi.title: CEI Know-how Exchange projects: distance learning on epidemics and pandemic outbreaks
nphi.with: National health institutes and ministries (not named)
nphi.summary: Two ISS-led projects, funded by Italy through the Central European Initiative (CEI), trained national health institutes in Belarus, Moldova, Ukraine and the Western Balkans on epidemic and pandemic response.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: Public health collaboration between Ukraine and Norway
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; Sunnaas hospital (NO)
nphi.summary: Strategic and technical twinning to build the capacity of the Public Health Center of Ukraine in IPC, crisis preparedness and health data. Later added mental health and rehabilitation training in war-affected areas.

nphi.title: Support to Ukraine for Developing a Modern Public Health System
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; Ministry of Health of Ukraine; GFA Consulting Group (co-implementer)
nphi.summary: EU-funded project (€5.8m) co-implemented by THL. It strengthened the Ukrainian Public Health Centre, aligned surveillance and response legislation with the EU, reformed blood safety and trained more than 1,500 professionals.

nphi.title: Joint WHO Europe–IANPHI seminars on building NPHIs through mergers
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Regional Office for Europe; merged NPHIs of Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden, UK
nphi.summary: WHO Europe and IANPHI held three seminars, in Kyiv (2017), Warsaw (2018) and Moldova (April 2019). Merged NPHIs from Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden and the UK shared their experience with countries setting up NPHIs: Ukraine, Moldova,…

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).
